title: One of the more perplexing aspects of these dreams from my perspective is the reason for the almost ubiquitous reports of problematic bathrooms. I think I might have an explanation for this.
content: https://philpapers.org/archive/MIDPP.pdf The linked article was actually the first reading assignment from my favorite philosophy class and I think it may help explain this issue. Please take a few minutes to read it, it’s quite easy and well worth it. I think it might be the case that the collective (un)?conscious is alerting us to some core or structural issues in our understanding or conception of reality and/or with the way we interface with ourselves and each-other as a fundamentally interconnected biological system at both the interpersonal and societal scale. We may well be developing into something like an immune system for the evolving mental domain of a conscious universe, with individuals being analogous to white blood cells or something like that… identifying and testing various thoughts, ideas, and concepts for efficacy and potential problems in the dream state before bringing them into physical existence. Edit: I don’t mean to suggest that that’s all we are, but I think it’s likely a piece of the puzzle and a part of the larger picture. You could also conceptualize it as a form of trans-temporal echolocation, guiding us through time away from potential dystopias and towards better timelines.
